messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a comprehensive sorting algorithms visualizer.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Implement 5 sorting algorithms: Bubble, Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix
- Visual bars with color coding: red (comparing), yellow (swapping), green (sorted), blue (pivot)
- Algorithm selection dropdown and speed control slider
- Toggle between step-by-step and continuous modes
- Real-time complexity analysis display (O-notation)
- Scramble button with patterns: Random, Reverse, Nearly Sorted
- Call stack depth visualization for recursive algorithms
- Real-time comparison and swap counters
- Working area highlighting for divide-and-conquer
- Smooth 60 FPS performance, no external libraries

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function createSortingVisualizer(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const width=canvas.width;const height=canvas.height;const barCount=100;let data=new Array(barCount);let colors=new Array(barCount).fill('gray');let compareSet=new Set();let swapSet=new Set();let sortedSet=new Set();let pivotIdx=null;let rangeStart=null,rangeEnd=null;let depth=0;let maxDepth=0;let compCount=0,swapCount=0;let speed=50;let continuous=true;let algorithm='Bubble';const algorithms={Bubble:{func:bubbleSort,complexity:'O(n²)'},Quick:{func:quickSort,complexity:'O(n log n)'},Merge:{func:mergeSort,complexity:'O(n log n)'},Heap:{func:heapSort,complexity:'O(n log n)'},Radix:{func:radixSort,complexity:'O(k·n)'}};function initData(){for(let i=0;i<barCount;i++)data[i]=i+1;}function shuffle(){for(let i=barCount-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[data[i],data[j]]=[data[j],data[i]];}}function reverse(){data=data.slice().reverse();}function nearlySorted(){shuffle();for(let i=0;i<10;i++){let a=Math.floor(Math.random()*barCount);let b=Math.floor(Math.random()*barCount);[data[a],data[b]]=[data[b],data[a]];}}function resetState(){colors.fill('gray');compareSet.clear();swapSet.clear();sortedSet.clear();pivotIdx=null;rangeStart=null;rangeEnd=null;depth=0;maxDepth=0;compCount=0;swapCount=0;}function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);let barW=width/barCount;for(let i=0;i<barCount;i++){let h=data[i]/barCount*height;let x=i*barW;let y=height-h;let color=colors[i];if(compareSet.has(i))color='red';else if(swapSet.has(i))color='yellow';else if(sortedSet.has(i))color='green';else if(i===pivotIdx)color='blue';else if(rangeStart!==null&&i>=rangeStart&&i<=rangeEnd)color='lightblue';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(x,y,barW-1,h);}ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('Algorithm: '+algorithm+' ('+algorithms[algorithm].complexity+')',10,20);ctx.fillText('Comparisons: '+compCount,10,40);ctx.fillText('Swaps: '+swapCount,10,60);ctx.fillText('Depth: '+depth,10,80);}let animationId=null;function start(){if(animationId)cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);function step(){draw();animationId=requestAnimationFrame(step);}step();}function runGenerator(gen){function next(){let res=gen.next();if(res.done){sortedSet=new Set([...Array(barCount).keys()]);pivotIdx=null;rangeStart=null;rangeEnd=null;return;}let act=res.value;processAction(act);if(continuous){setTimeout(next,speed);}else{document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled=false;}}next();}function processAction(act){compareSet.clear();swapSet.clear();pivotIdx=null;rangeStart=null;rangeEnd=null;switch(act.type){case'compare':compareSet.add(act.i);compareSet.add(act.j);compCount++;break;case'swap':[data[act.i],data[act.j]]=[data[act.j],data[act.i]];swapSet.add(act.i);swapSet.add(act.j);swapCount++;break;case'pivot':pivotIdx=act.i;break;case'range':rangeStart=act.start;rangeEnd=act.end;break;case'sorted':sortedSet.add(act.i);break;case'depth':depth=act.val;if(act.val>maxDepth)maxDepth=act.val;break;}}function* bubbleSort(arr){let n=arr.length;let swapped;do{swapped=false;for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){yield{type:'compare',i,i+1};if(arr[i]>arr[i+1]){yield{type:'swap',i,i+1};[arr[i],arr[i+1]]=[arr[i+1],arr[i]];swapped=true;}}n--;for(let i=0;i<barCount;i++)if(i>=n)yield{type:'sorted',i};}while(swapped);}function* quickSort(arr,l=0,r=arr.length-1,dep=1){yield{type:'depth',val:dep};if(l<r){let p=yield* partition(arr,l,r,dep);yield{type:'range',start:l,end:r};yield* quickSort(arr,l,p-1,dep+1);yield* quickSort(arr,p+1,r,dep+1);}else if(l===r){yield{type:'sorted',i:l};}}function* partition(arr,l,r,dep){let pivot=arr[r];pivotIdx=r;yield{type:'pivot',i:r};let i=l-1;for(let j=l;j<r;j++){yield{type:'compare',i:j};if(arr[j]<=pivot){i++;yield{type:'swap',i,j};[arr[i],arr[j]]=[arr[j],arr[i]];}}yield{type:'swap',i+1,r};[arr[i+1],arr[r]]=[arr[r],arr[i+1]];yield{type:'sorted',i:i+1};return i+1;}function* mergeSort(arr,l=0,r=arr.length-1,dep=1){yield{type:'depth',val:dep};if(l<r){let m=Math.floor((l+r)/2);yield* mergeSort(arr,l,m,dep+1);yield* mergeSort(arr,m+1,r,dep+1);yield* merge(arr,l,m,r);}else if(l===r){yield{type:'sorted',i:l};}}function* merge(arr,l,m,r){let n1=m-l+1,n2=r-m;let L=arr.slice(l,m+1),R=arr.slice(m+1,r+1);let i=0,j=0,k=l;while(i<n1&&j<n2){yield{type:'compare',i:l+i,j:m+1+j};if(L[i]<=R[j]){arr[k]=L[i];yield{type:'sorted',i:k};i++;}else{arr[k]=R[j];yield{type:'sorted',i:k};j++;}k++;}while(i<n1){arr[k]=L[i];yield{type:'sorted',i:k};i++;k++;}while(j<n2){arr[k]=R[j];yield{type:'sorted',i:k};j++;k++;}}function* heapSort(arr){let n=arr.length;function* heapify(n,i){let largest=i;let l=2*i+1,r=2*i+2;if(l<n){yield{type:'compare',i:l,j:largest};if(arr[l]>arr[largest])largest=l;}if(r<n){yield{type:'compare',i:r,j:largest};if(arr[r]>arr[largest])largest=r;}if(largest!==i){yield{type:'swap',i,i:largest};[arr[i],arr[largest]]=[arr[largest],arr[i]];yield* heapify(n,largest);} }for(let i=Math.floor(n/2)-1;i>=0;i--)yield* heapify(n,i);for(let i=n-1;i>0;i--){yield{type:'swap',i:0,j:i};[arr[0],arr[i]]=[arr[i],arr[0]];yield* heapify(i,0);}for(let i=0;i<n;i++)yield{type:'sorted',i};}function* radixSort(arr){let max=Math.max(...arr);let exp=1;while(Math.floor(max/exp)>0){let output=new Array(arr.length).fill(0);let count=new Array(10).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){let digit=Math.floor(arr[i]/exp)%10;count[digit]++;}for(let i=1;i<10;i++)count[i]+=count[i-1];for(let i=arr.length-1;i>=0;i--){let digit=Math.floor(arr[i]/exp)%10;output[count[digit]-1]=arr[i];count[digit]--;}for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){if(arr[i]!==output[i]){let j=arr.indexOf(output[i]);yield{type:'swap',i,j};[arr[i],arr[j]]=[arr[j],arr[i]];}}exp*=10;}for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++)yield{type:'sorted',i};}function createUI(){const container=document.createElement('div');container.style.display='flex';container.style.alignItems='center';container.style.marginTop='10px';const algSelect=document.createElement('select');for(let key in algorithms){let opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=key;opt.textContent=key;algSelect.appendChild(opt);}algSelect.value=algorithm;algSelect.onchange=()=>{algorithm=algSelect.value;resetState();initData();draw();};container.appendChild(algSelect);const speedLabel=document.createElement('label');speedLabel.textContent=' Speed ';container.appendChild(speedLabel);const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='10';speedSlider.max='200';speedSlider.value=speed;speedSlider.oninput=()=>{speed=parseInt(speedSlider.value);};container.appendChild(speedSlider);const modeLabel=document.createElement('label');modeLabel.textContent=' Continuous ';container.appendChild(modeLabel);const modeChk=document.createElement('input');modeChk.type='checkbox';modeChk.checked=continuous;modeChk.onchange=()=>{continuous=modeChk.checked;document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled=!continuous;};container.appendChild(modeChk);const nextBtn=document.createElement('button');nextBtn.id='nextBtn';nextBtn.textContent='Next Step';nextBtn.disabled=!continuous;nextBtn.onclick=()=>{if(currentGen){document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled=true;runGeneratorStep();}};container.appendChild(nextBtn);const scrambleBtn=document.createElement('button');scrambleBtn.textContent='Scramble';scrambleBtn.onclick=()=>{let pattern=prompt('Pattern: Random, Reverse, Nearly','Random');if(pattern)pattern=pattern.toLowerCase();resetState();if(pattern==='reverse')reverse();else if(pattern==='nearly')nearlySorted();else shuffle();draw();};container.appendChild(scrambleBtn);canvas.parentNode.insertBefore(container,canvas.nextSibling);}let currentGen=null;function startSort(){resetState();initData();draw();currentGen=algorithms[algorithm].func(data.slice());runGenerator(currentGen);}function runGeneratorStep(){let res=currentGen.next();if(res.done){sortedSet=new Set([...Array(barCount).keys()]);pivotIdx=null;rangeStart=null;rangeEnd=null;draw();return;}processAction(res.value);draw();if(!continuous)document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled=false;}createUI();startSort();start();}
